name: Smoked-out shuffle trap
desc: Lazy triplet-shuffle sibling of the hat-rolls kit: elongation-swung hats that rotate through the bar via iter, 808 snare instead of clap, drowsy open-hat answers — codeine tempo swagger.

code.full: stack(s("bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ bd ~").bank("RolandTR808").shape(.3).gain(${gain}), s("~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR808").room(${room}).gain(${gain}*.75), s("[hh@2 hh]*4").bank("RolandTR808").ply("<1 1 2 1>").gain("[.42 .3 .38 .26]").iter(4).lpf(sine.range(${bright}*.6, ${bright}*1.2).slow(32)).fast(${rate}), s("~ ~ oh ~ ~ ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(.3).mask("<0 1 1 1>")).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~").bank("RolandTR808").shape(.35).gain(${gain}), s("~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR808").room(${room}).gain(${gain}*.75).every(8, x=>x.ply(2)), s("[hh@2 hh]*4").bank("RolandTR808").ply("<2 1 3 1>").gain("[.46 .32 .42 .3]").iter(8).lpf(sine.range(${bright}*.8, ${bright}*1.5).slow(16)).fast(${rate}), s("~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [hh hh hh] ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(.4).every(4, x=>x.fast(2))).orbit(1).play()
